messages:
sara: Heads-up — sampleapp's rerank flow started failing on staging after yesterday's SDK parity pass. getting vector length errors on batched calls. :frowning:
mike: ugh, what error exactly?
sara: server log: `InvalidVectorLength: received 768, expected 1024` when calling /v1/rerank with batched embeddings
alex: are you using the new `shard_and_pad` helper in node sdk? we shipped a change that pads to shard-size instead of model-dim.
sara: yes node sdk. python sample app uses `pad_to_dim` helper which pads to model-dim. so node is returning 1024-padded vectors but embedding backend sees 768.
priya: that sounds inverted? node -> shard-pad -> bigger vectors, backend expects smaller? can you paste the request body snippet?
sara: sure

```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "inputs": [...batch...],
  "batching": {"shard_size": 256, "strategy": "shard_and_pad"}
}
```

response (node sdk):
```
{"vectors": [[...768 values...],[...768...]]}
```

response (python sdk):
```
{"embeddings": [[...1024 values...],[...1024...]]}
```

alex: ok so node returned 768 but marked as shard-padded? so the shape vs field name mismatch too. backend expects `embeddings` key and full dim, plus rerank expects lengths to match query vectors.
rita: i reproduced locally — when shard_size < model_dim, node helper trims the vector metadata field to `vectors` and doesn't update the declared `dim` header. result: consumer (rerank) assumes model_dim and fails.
priya: could be an auth/retry edge too: deploy-bot shows 2 duplicate embed requests for the same batch (retries triggered by 401->refresh). double-padding and then de-duping code assumed stable shape.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: deploy finished: sdk-node@1.12.3 -> 1.12.4 (parity patch)

mike: timeline: parity patch landed, then we updated shard helper behavior. Node -> shard-first, Python -> pad-to-dim. So inconsistency introduced.
sara: impact: staging search/rerank shows 15% error rate and some flakiness in sampleapp onboarding flow. customers ondedicated might see mismatch if they use helper.
alex: short term: revert node helper to pad_to_dim by default. medium: unify helper naming and add explicit `pad_to: "model_dim" | "shard_size"` option.
rita: i'll open PR to revert and add tests. also add validation in `embeddings` response codepath: if vector length != model_dim, throw clear error rather than letting rerank crash.
priya: add a quick CLI shim in sampleapp to assert dims before sending to rerank, and log a helpful message so onboarding isn't blocked.
sara: can we also handle auth-retry duplication? maybe tie retries to idempotency keys at batch level.
mike: agreed. add idempotency per-batch SHA256, server will ignore duplicate batch ids for 10s.

alex: created issue #4127 with plan + test matrix. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/489
rita: PR opened to revert and add tests -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/490 :nod:
priya: I'll patch sampleapp with an assert and a note in onboarding README.
sara: thanks all. action items: revert node helper (rita), add server-side validation (alex), sampleapp assert + README (priya), idempotency for batch retries (mike). I'll follow up in tomorrow sync. :thumbsup:
mike: ping me if you need help with rollout gating or a quick hotfix build.
rita: merging in 30m and will watch staging metrics. :eyes:
priya: patch deployed to staging, sampleapp now logs this message when mismatch: "Vector dim mismatch: expected 1024, got 768 — check SDK helper parity".
sara: closing the thread unless something else pops up. thanks everyone! :party:
